title: 第19章 任太爷袭来第20章 紫霄神雷起
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
啪嗒。
忽然，门外响起一阵阵沉重的跳踏声。
每一步都发出清脆的声响，如同马蹄在敲击地面。
众人朝门外望去。
转瞬即逝，一只僵尸出现在任府大门。
啊啊！
僵尸露出叫吼一声，露出锋利的獠牙。
朝院内跳来。
来者正是任老爷的父亲，任老太爷。
四人神态各异望向大门。
“爸……”
任老爷如字眼卡吼一般，惊恐的朝门外指去。
“鬼啊！”
堂内家庭吓的失声大叫。
慌忙逃窜。
任婷婷吓的花容失色。
颤抖的双手紧紧抓着林凡身后的衣尾。
是时候展现真正的技术了。
能否抱得美人归就看这一次啦！
秋生心中笑喜颜开。

仿佛已经能梦到，与任婷婷在婚礼殿堂的画面。
见任婷婷如此惊慌失措，秋生突的犹如猛虎一般。
飞身朝门外往任老太爷冲去。
凭借着冲刺的加速，纵身跃起。
凌空一脚，直直朝任老太爷心口踢去。
秋生对自己的拳脚功夫，还是稍有自信的。
嘭！
一声闷响，任老太爷应声倒下。
“任小姐，别害怕有我秋生在。就不可能让你受伤。”
秋生笔直的走向大堂。
竖着大拇指朝自己的脸上指去，一副信心满满的样子。
朝任婷婷邀功，将自己的男子汉形象展现的淋漓尽致。
浑然忘记，身后的是只僵尸。
还是一只欲要突破成紫僵的存在。
只见任老太爷瞬间起身。
双手瞬间死死勒住了秋生的脖颈。
content_en:
Snap.
Suddenly, there was a heavy thumping sound outside the door.
Every step made a crisp sound, like a horse's hooves hitting the ground.
Everyone looked out the door.
In a blink of an eye, a zombie appeared at the gate of Ren's mansion.
Ah!
The zombie roared and revealed its sharp fangs.
Jumped towards the courtyard.
The person who came was none other than Mr. Ren’s father, Mrs. Ren.
The four people looked at the door with different expressions.
"Dad..."
Master Ren pointed towards the door in horror as if his words were stuck.
"Ghost!"
The families in the hall were so frightened that they screamed.
Flee in a hurry.
Ren Tingting was so frightened that her face turned pale.
Trembling hands tightly grasped the tail of Lin Fan's clothes behind him.
It's time to show off the real technology.
It depends on this time whether you can hold the beauty in your arms!
Qiu Sheng smiled in his heart.
It seems that I can already dream about the scene with Ren Tingting in the wedding hall.
Seeing Ren Tingting so panicked, Qiu Sheng was as sudden as a tiger.
He flew towards the door and rushed towards Mr. Ren.
Relying on the acceleration of sprinting, he jumped up.
A kick in the air went straight towards Mr. Ren's heart.
Qiu Sheng was somewhat confident in his boxing and kicking skills.
Bang!
There was a muffled sound, and Old Man Ren fell down.
"Miss Ren, don't be afraid as long as I, Qiu Sheng, am here. I won't let you get hurt."
Qiu Sheng walked straight towards the lobby.
He pointed his thumb towards his face, looking confident.
Chao Ren Tingting took credit and showed his manly image to the fullest.
He completely forgot that the person behind him was a zombie.
It is still an existence that wants to break through into purple zombies.
I saw Mrs. Ren standing up instantly.
His hands instantly strangled Qiu Sheng's neck.
